sources.quote: The cost of a simple house with standard materials ranges from ₹1,400 to ₹1,800 per square foot, which includes essential fittings and finishes without luxury features.

sources.title: House Construction Cost in Pune
sources.quote: Basic residential construction may start around ₹1,600–₹1,900 per sq ft, while standard homes often fall around ₹1,900–₹2,500 per sq ft. Premium or luxury specifications can go higher.

sources.title: Construction Company in Pune
sources.quote: Basic: ₹1,680 per sqft

sources.title: Construction Cost per Sqft in Pune 2026 — ₹2,573
sources.quote: Basic quality starts at ~₹2,007/sqft, Premium at ~₹3,474/sqft, and Luxury at ~₹4,760/sqft. Pune construction cost: ₹2,573/sqft Standard, ₹3,474 Premium as of August 2026.

notes: Cited Pune figures per sq ft for basic or budget specification: NoBroker basic ₹1,800–₹2,200; Construction Estimator India low-cost ₹1,300–₹1,800 (Pune estimator page) and basic ₹1,700–₹2,500 (its city table); Square Yards basic ₹1,400–₹1,800; Brick & Bolt basic ₹1,600–₹1,900 (Pune guide) and its Basic package ₹1,680; InfraLens basic from ~₹2,007. Sources disagree, so the range is widened to ₹1,300–₹2,500. Expected = median of one midpoint per publisher (a publisher with several figures contributes the median of its own midpoints), rounded to the nearest ₹25 with ties down: midpoints 1,600 (Square Yards), 1,715 (Brick & Bolt), 1,825 (Construction Estimator India), 2,000 (NoBroker), 2,007 (InfraLens) → 1,825. Brick & Bolt's packages (Basic, Classic, Premium, Royale, Luxury Homes) are mapped to tiers by price position, not by name: Basic → budget. Brick & Bolt also showed an older Pune price set (Basic ₹1,560) on another page; the current set is used. Unit is sq ft of built-up area summed across floors; most sources state only 'per sq ft' without naming the area measure, so check the measure on any quote. Material-and-labour (turnkey) rates throughout; no labour-only or shell-only figure is mixed in. GST basis is not stated by most sources; the search summary labelled Brick & Bolt's package prices as inclusive of GST, which was not checked against the page. Quotes were taken from search-result text because page fetches were blocked (bricknbolt.com returned EGRESS_BLOCKED); re-check each figure against the live page before review. Locality factors are left empty: Square Yards says Baner, Kothrud and Viman Nagar cost more than Wagholi and Hinjewadi, while InfraLens' zone table puts Hinjewadi above Kothrud and Baner, so the sources disagree. Component fractions: labour 0.22 sits inside NoBroker's Pune figure of labour at 20-25% of total cost (InfraLens gives 25-28% for Pune; NoBroker's national 1,200 sq ft guide gives 15-20%); the 0.10 for preparation, transport and waste is an editorial assumption, and materials take the remaining 0.68. The same split is used for all three turnkey tiers. Verifier (2026-10-06): all source refs were re-checked against the builder's search results (URL present, quote verbatim, URL listed in the same result as the quote), and the expected value recomputes exactly under the stated rule. GST basis is unresolved across publishers. A verifier spot-check search over NoBroker, Construction Estimator India, InfraLens and Square Yards returned two contradictory statements that could not be tied to a page: one said the rates are inclusive of GST, the other said to add 8–12% for permits, architect fees, GST and contingencies. Brick & Bolt's package prices were again labelled inclusive of GST in a second search summary. The figures may therefore differ by the GST amount; confirm each source's GST basis on the live page before review. A verifier search restricted to constructionestimatorindia.com for the Pune basic ₹1,700–2,500 and premium ₹2,800–4,200 figures returned 'Cost of Building a House in India 2026' as the top result, which supports the page attribution of that quote.

sources.title: What Is The Construction Cost In Pune 2026?
sources.quote: The RCC construction cost in Pune is Rs 900-1200 per sqft.

notes: Cited Pune figures per sq ft for structural (shell) work with materials and labour: Construction Estimator India civil and structural works ₹800–₹1,500 (excavation, foundation, RCC frame, slabs, masonry, waterproofing); Home Bazaar RCC construction ₹900–₹1,200. Neither source sells a named 'grey structure' package, and neither separates specification tiers, so this is one model at the standard tier. What counts as grey structure varies (plaster, tanks and conduits may or may not be in), so compare quotes item by item. Range ₹800–₹1,500. Expected = median of the two publishers' midpoints (1,150 and 1,050) = 1,100. Cross-checks not used as sources: NoBroker's Pune guide puts civil work at 45-50% of total cost, which on its standard ₹2,200–₹2,700 gives roughly ₹990–₹1,350; Brick & Bolt's Ghaziabad guide gives grey structure at ₹1,100–₹1,400 (another city); a national Studio Matrx figure of ₹1,500–₹2,000 for the shell was seen in a general search but could not be tied to one page, and is higher than both Pune sources. Quotes were taken from search-result text because page fetches were blocked; re-check against the live pages before review. GST basis not stated. Locality factors left empty (no Pune locality data for shell work). Component fractions: materials 0.62 and labour 0.28 follow Construction Estimator India's split of RCC work into materials 60-65%, labour 25-30% and overheads 10% (its national RCC cost guide, seen only in search text); the remaining 0.10 is split editorially into preparation 0.04 (excavation and site work), transport 0.03 and waste 0.03. Verifier (2026-10-06): refs re-checked against the builder's search results; expected recomputes exactly. A verifier search restricted to homebazaar.com returned the same page, now titled 'What Is The Construction Cost In Pune 2026?' (the builder saw '2025?'), with the same RCC figure of Rs 900-1200 per sqft listed separately from the citywide Rs 1,500 to Rs 2,500 average, which supports reading it as a structure-only rate. The SourceRef title was updated to the current title.

sources.title: 1200 Sq Ft House Construction Cost in India 2026
sources.quote: Labor-only rates when directly hiring labor are ₹350–₹550 per sq ft, which transfers full responsibility for materials, supervision, and timelines to the owner.

sources.title: 3BHK House Construction Cost in India 2026
sources.quote: Labour contract rates range from ₹300 – ₹500 per sq. ft. for a total labor-only package in India.

notes: National figures, not Pune-specific: no Pune labour-only rate per sq ft was found. NoBroker gives ₹350–₹550 per sq ft for labour-only work in its 1,200 sq ft guide (its 600 sq ft guide showed ₹300–₹500 in search text); Construction Estimator India gives ₹300–₹500 per sq ft for a labour-only package. Labour-only basis only: the owner buys all materials, which are not in this rate. Range ₹300–₹550. Expected = median of the two publishers' midpoints (450 and 400) = 425. Not mixed in: InfraLens puts labour at 25-28% of a Pune standard build, about ₹550–₹755 per sq ft; that is the labour share inside a turnkey rate, not a labour-contract price. Construction Estimator India says a labour-only contract can save 10-15% over turnkey if the owner has time to supervise. Check whether shuttering, scaffolding, curing and site water are in the labour rate. Components: the rate is labour by definition (labour 1.0); materials, transport and waste are paid by the owner outside it. Quotes were taken from search-result text because page fetches were blocked; re-check against the live pages before review. GST basis not stated. Verifier (2026-10-06): refs re-checked against the builder's search results; expected recomputes exactly. No change.
